[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. The feet stamp and splash in the puddles and the reflected lights break into rings, while the camera tracks slowly with the feet, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
